_doc: What the human-view bot can see (Batch 2, BACKLOG-R4). The camera box mirrors packages/render-3d/src/units.ts (the bots never import render code; packages/bots/test/view.test.ts checks these against it). viewW is the ground width across the screen in world units: units.ts LABEL_VIEW_W, about the mean of VIEW_W at the look point (200) and the wider ground at the top edge. aspect is the play area's height over width on a portrait phone (390x844 less the HUD rows). heroShift is the share of the screen height the look point sits above the hero (renderer followCamera).
